tempio spagnolo (spanish temple)

Synagogue · Roma, Italy

The Spanish Synagogue (Tempio Spagnolo) is a Sephardic synagogue located beneath the Great Synagogue of Rome. Inaugurated in 1932, its elegant interior preserves important furnishings and decorative elements from Rome’s historic Cinque Scole, the five synagogues that once stood in the Jewish Ghetto. The sanctuary features a distinctive square dome, richly decorated Baroque elements, and historic seating dating from the 17th century.

The synagogue remains an active place of worship and can generally be visited as part of a visit or guided tour of the Jewish Museum of Rome, located in the same monumental complex.
